arguments.sql: SELECT r.start_date,b.project_no,COUNT(*) AS records,SUM(r.fee_amount) AS actual_fee,SUM(ROUND(r.principal*r.fee_rate,2)) AS calculated_fee,SUM(r.fee_amount<>ROUND(r.principal*r.fee_rate,2)) AS mismatched_rows,MIN(r.fee_rate) AS min_rate,MAX(r.fee_rate) AS max_rate FROM ol_saps.bill_fee_record r JOIN ol_saps.customer_bill b ON b.bill_no=r.bill_no AND b.is_delete=0 WHERE r.start_date IN ('2026-11-12','2026-11-13') AND r.end_date=r.start_date AND r.is_delete=0 GROUP BY r.start_date,b.project_no LIMIT 10
